name: find-and-fix-ripgrep-paths
description: Multi-tool workflow: grep to find the findRipgrep() function, read_file to understand it, edit_file to add a fallback path. Tests grep + read_file + edit_file pipeline.
task: In the Yrden codebase, there is a GrepTool implementation at Sources/Yrden/Tools/GrepTool.swift. It has a findRipgrep() function with a hardcoded list of candidate paths for the ripgrep binary. Find that function, read the current list of candidates, and add '/usr/bin/env' as a fourth fallback entry at the end of the candidates array (after the existing three paths). Do not change any other code.
